Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk

Interface PerkService

public interface PerkService
Rank-based limits from perks.yml: named tiers tied to permissions, and temporary boosts given to single players.

A player belongs to the enabled tier with the highest priority whose permission they hold. Every perk the tier does not set, and every perk of a player without a tier, follows the server-wide default: settings.yml for host limits, party size and scenario settings, and the defaults of perks.yml for the rest. Active boosts apply on top.

Zentrix asks for a perk when the player acts - creating a game, inviting someone - so a rank that expires takes nothing away the player already has. When a perk stops a player, PerkLimitReachedEvent fires.

Reads answer at once, on the main thread, from what Zentrix holds for online players. Boost changes are stored with the player's data, work for offline players and complete on the main thread; they complete exceptionally while storage is unavailable. 


 PerkService perks = ZentrixAPI.get().getPerkService();
 int slots = perks.getNumber(player, Perk.CUSTOM_GAMES_MAX_HOSTED);
 perks.grantBoost(player.getUniqueId(), Perk.CUSTOM_GAMES_MAX_HOSTED, 1, Duration.ofHours(24), "shop");
Since:
1.9.0

    • grantBoost

      @NotNull @NotNull CompletableFuture<PerkBoost> grantBoost(@NotNull @NotNull UUID playerId, @NotNull @NotNull Perk perk, int amount, @NotNull @NotNull Duration duration, @NotNull @NotNull String source)
      Gives a player a temporary boost, online or offline. It ends on its own after duration.
      Parameters:
      amount - added to a number perk; must be positive. Ignored by a toggle perk, which the boost allows
      duration - how long it lasts; must be positive
      source - who or what gave it, kept with the boost
      Returns:
      completes on the main thread with the boost as stored
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the amount or duration is not positive
